name: Análisis de Bokeh
mechanism:
This method analyzes bokeh (out-of-focus rendering) naturalness for forensic detection:

1. **Profundidad - of - Field Map Estimación**: The image is analyzed to estimate relative depth across the frame using defocus cues. Regions are classified by their blur level — sharp (in-focus), slightly blurred, and heavily blurred, creating a depth-ordered defocus map.

2. **Bokeh Disc Análisis**: Out-of-focus highlights are identified and their shape (bokeh disc) is analyzed. Real lenses produce bokeh discs with shapes determined by the aperture blade count and shape — circular, hexagonal, or octagonal with consistent geometry across the frame. AI-generated bokeh often produces physically impossible disc shapes or inconsistent shapes at different frame positions.

3. **Defocus Gradiente Consistencia**: The transition from sharp to blurred regions should follow a smooth gradient consistent with optical depth-of-field physics (proportional to 1/distance from focal plane). AI generators may produce abrupt focus transitions, incorrect blur gradient directions, or depth-of-field effects inconsistent with any physical lens.

4. **Chromatic Aberration in Bokeh**: Real out-of-focus regions exhibit longitudinal chromatic aberration — color fringing with green/magenta shifts depending on whether the object is in front of or behind the focal plane. The method checks for correct chromatic behavior in bokeh regions. Generated images typically lack or incorrectly render chromatic bokeh effects.

5. **Temporal Bokeh Consistencia**: In video, bokeh characteristics should vary smoothly with camera-to-subject distance changes. The method tracks bokeh quality across frames — generated video may produce inconsistent frame-to-frame bokeh rendering, with disc shapes, blur amounts, or chromatic effects that fluctuate without corresponding depth changes.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante bokeh naturalness analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-generated images are surprisingly easy to spot. CVPR.
